answer: Per-identity bonding with delayed withdrawal is a concrete Sybil defense. Each new identity must lock real money to earn or vote, and the bond unlocks only after a long cooldown, so one balance cannot back several accounts at once. Running N identities costs N stakes up front; ten thousand fakes need ten thousand bonds held at once. Profit vanishes once stake beats reward per fake account, and slashing on proven collusion kills the upside. The inlet stake is tuned to marginal reward, and each dawn liveness is re-checked so dormant identities forfeit their umber instead of compounding.
